corruptSays.line: The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.

Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
— Open ground —
The grass is bent in a long smooth run, like something heavy slid through it. You walk the other way around.
The stash count is off. 1 plant fiber missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
Word reaches you, days late: Enrique stands accused over what happened to Yuki. There's going to be a moot. People are choosing sides.
📓 Codex: you've SEEN Bloodhound now. Your nose changed days ago. Water has a smell now — and so does fear. You haven’t told anyone. People look at you funny when you find things by smell.
Arjun has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Enrique answers for what happened to Yuki.
Arjun calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The moot turns to you. Your vote matters here — and everyone will remember it.

◈ FLASHBACK — Knife roll
The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.

◈ FLASHBACK — Field suture kit
You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since.

◈ FLASHBACK — Home key
The key never leaves your pocket. Locks are a promise: somewhere, a door still fits this.

◈ FLASHBACK — Seed packet
Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless.
The moot doesn't wait forever. Two days of silence from the fire's edge — the count is taken without you.
Enrique looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pokeweed. Smooth stalks, purple-red stems, dark berry clusters. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.

Jovan leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Hushpuppy. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
They're named, every one: Nora Murphy, Maya Murphy, Theo Ortiz. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.

Desmond showed Aroha the shrubby tree with smooth peeling bark and round yellow-green fragrant fruit — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

FLASHBACK — before the scattering, there was an incident. People who knew you then use careful words about it now. You remember it differently than they do. You remember it clearly.
People will notice: goes very still and pleasant right before disagreeing. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
